nfe_definition: Euler vector-field evaluations per generated audio patch, one per step (experiments/nfe_benchmark.py)

sim.sim_ref: cosine similarity of the clip to the reference voice it was cloned from
sim.sim_hi_nfe: cosine similarity to the same prompt and seed at the highest NFE (hi_nfe)

metrics.wer: Whisper small via tts_eval_org (Arush); WER with any re-spoken reference intro removed, capped at 1
metrics.latency: generation time per clip (latency_ms); rtf = latency / audio length

missing_audio.description: The WAV file is not on disk.

unreadable_audio.description: The WAV file could not be decoded.

too_short.description: Shorter than 0.5 s: too little audio for a speaker embedding.

silent.description: (Near-)silent: peak below 0.01 (about -40 dBFS) or RMS below 1e-4. A failed generation, not a quiet voice.

asr_rejected.description: The ASR step rejected the clip, so its WER and CER are not a real measurement.

score_error.description: The SIM scorer failed on this clip.

contaminated_continuation.description: Generated in continuation mode: the reference transcript ("Hey, Adam here...") leaks into the output.

truncated_at_cap.description: Stopped at the generation length cap (max_generate_length), usually mid-sentence, so WER measures the cap, not NFE.

missing_metric.description: SIM, WER, CER, latency or RTF is missing.

latency_outlier.description: RTF is over 3x the median for its run, NFE and length bucket (warm-up or a noisy machine). Kept in the latency numbers.

signal_check_failed.description: Failed the team's signal check (clipping, long leading silence, a pause over 1 s, or an abrupt end). Worth listening to.
